note.question: What determines a multiclass queueing model of a telephone call center in which a system manager dynamically allocates available servers to customer calls?
note.overview: The model considers a multiclass queueing model of a telephone call center in which a system manager dynamically allocates available servers to customer calls. Calls can terminate through either service completion or customer abandonment, and the manager strives to minimize the expected total of holding costs plus abandonment costs over a finite horizon. Using this computational method, we propose a policy for the original (prelimit) call center scheduling problem.
